name: describe-alarm-aws
description: Read-only child: current state and reason of one CloudWatch alarm, on any account passed in.

definition.llm_description: Read-only child: current state and reason of one CloudWatch alarm, on any account passed in.

params.command: aws cloudwatch describe-alarms --alarm-names {{ Inputs.alarm_name }} --region {{ Inputs.region }} --query "MetricAlarms[].[AlarmName,StateValue,StateReason]" --output json
